_readme: Staged coming-soon images + text, shown ONLY in the local theme preview (127.0.0.1/localhost) by snippets/custom-cs-staging.liquid. Keys are product handles. Slots: skinsafe, rows {1..3}, steps {1..4}, banner. Each entry: src (file in assets/ or full https URL), alt, optional title/text (rows, steps) or heading (banner), status (staged|published). Publishing to the dev store happens at the end, then entries are marked published.

skinsafe.alt: The open Fresh Beauty palette on a sunlit travertine vanity, its seashell, dusty rose and deep mauve shades swatched on the stone beside a pale pink rose

1.alt: Nikol holds the open Fresh Beauty palette beside her cheek, a soft rose pearl blended across her eyelids

2.alt: Nikol holds the open Fresh Beauty palette in her palm, its seashell, dusty rose and deep mauve shades swatched on three fingertips

3.alt: At a sunny café table, Nikol slips the closed Fresh Beauty compact, with its rose line-art lid and N monogram, into her camel handbag

banner.alt: Nikol laughing with her eyes closed and hands at her cheeks, wearing Fresh Beauty: a soft rose-mauve wash across the lids, deeper at the outer corners

skinsafe.alt: The open Le Bottled Blonde palette on a round vanity mirror tray in golden-hour light, its rose gold, golden taupe and bronze toffee pans reflected below, beside dried wheat

1.alt: Nikol in warm golden-hour light, glancing to the side, golden taupe satin warming her lids with no sparkle

2.alt: Overhead close-up of the open Le Bottled Blonde palette on cream linen, the bronze toffee pan crushed and its sponge applicator resting across the rose gold, golden taupe and bronze shades

3.alt: Nikol holds the open Le Bottled Blonde palette at eye level against a soft blue wall, its mirror reflecting the champagne beige, caramel tan and taupe brown shimmer pans

banner.alt: Nikol with a calm, happy smile and eyes gently closed, wearing Le Bottled Blonde: golden taupe satin blending into bronze toffee at the outer corners

skinsafe.alt: The open Naughty Nancy palette on a blush marble vanity in evening window light, its sparkling mauve, plum pink and sugar deep plum pans beside the rose line-art compact and a sprig of dried heather

1.alt: Nikol in warm evening lamplight holding the open Naughty Nancy palette at her collarbone, wearing a soft smoky eye in plum pink and sugar deep plum

2.alt: Close-up of hands holding the open Naughty Nancy palette and lifting its sponge applicator, dusted with sugar deep plum, from the darkest pan against a soft plum-taupe backdrop

3.alt: Sparkling mauve, plum pink and sugar deep plum swatched side by side on dark slate below the open Naughty Nancy palette, each shimmering in low evening light

banner.alt: Nikol smiling with her eyes closed to show plum pink lids blended into sugar deep plum, holding the open Naughty Nancy palette beside her cheek

skinsafe.alt: The open Sweet Carol palette in powder pink, smoked grape and plum brown on pale pink linen beside its rose line-art compact, jojoba seeds, a vial of oil and a sunflower in morning light

1.alt: Hands tilt the open Sweet Carol palette toward a sunlit window, the pearlized smoked grape shade catching the light between the velvety matte powder pink and plum brown

2.alt: Nikol holds the open Sweet Carol palette beside her jaw, her eyes defined with smoked grape on the lid and rich plum brown at the outer corner

3.alt: The open Sweet Carol palette on a dusty-rose leather makeup pouch with its two double-ended sponge applicators beside it, tipped in powder pink and plum brown

banner.alt: Nikol laughing with her eyes closed, her lids soft matte smoked grape deepening to plum brown at the outer corners

skinsafe.alt: The open Cabana palette in crisp champagne, iced pink and toffee bronze on a white-washed poolside table beside its rose line-art compact, a striped towel and lemon water under palm shadows

1.alt: A hand holds the open Cabana palette over a sunlit pool, its crisp champagne, iced pink and toffee bronze pans sharing the same pearly sheen

2.alt: Poolside in a white linen shirt, Nikol checks her eyes in the mirror of the open Cabana palette, its rose line-art lid facing the camera

3.alt: A hand holds up one of the Cabana palette's double-ended sponge applicators, its tip dusted with toffee bronze, above the open palette on a sunny poolside table
3.text: Tucked beneath the shades are two dual-ended applicators custom-designed by Nikol Beauty, each with a soft sponge tip at both ends. Press color on with one end, then use the clean end to soften and diffuse it.

banner.alt: Nikol smiling warmly with the open Cabana palette beside her face, her lids in iced pink softened with toffee bronze at the outer corners

skinsafe.alt: The open Strong Brew palette in matte nude peach, soft taupe and rich brown on a walnut cafe counter with its rose line-art compact, shea butter, rice powder, coffee beans and a cappuccino

1.alt: Fingertips hold the Strong Brew sponge applicator above the untouched matte palette, angled on a gold mirrored tray on a cafe counter
1.text: Every palette tucks two dual-ended applicators under the pans, each with a soft sponge tip at both ends. Pat color on with the sponge; the Shea butter formula melts onto the lid for comfortable wear.

2.alt: Nikol smiles to the side holding the open Strong Brew palette in one hand, its matte nude peach, soft taupe and rich brown running light to deep

3.alt: Creamy nude peach, soft taupe and rich brown swatched on oatmeal linen as soft, even matte color with no sparkle, beside the open Strong Brew palette

banner.alt: Nikol smiling warmly with the open Strong Brew palette held at her cheek, her lids in matte soft taupe deepened with rich brown
